rule: Everything below lives under ~/.misha, unless the MISHA_HOME environment variable names another folder. These are the paths Misha's code builds; Claude Code, OpenCode, the browser and the browser extension keep their own data elsewhere.

paths.description: The settings, inbox, outbox and ledger.
Where your Claude Code or OpenCode reaches the running app; only you may open it.
The clone's own read-only copies of your repositories.
The files a reply of the clone attaches, kept until they are posted.
What one run's tools write, emptied as a run starts and ends.
A Slack image read for the model, deleted once it answered.
The working copies workers change code in.
What the extension installers keep per harness.
What was installed into Claude Code, per extension.
What was installed into OpenCode, per extension.
What the extension installers moved aside before writing over it.
